body: 15 Nov 2026, THE ADVISOR'S RULINGS on the decisions D1 to D14 of the P2-25 design refresh (PR #98), applied in the design text by helper-p225: D1 Arabic table ACCEPTED, cross-checked against Lucene's ArabicNormalizationFilter and PersianNormalizationFilter (cite them); the ة→ه loss is accepted because identity also uses artist and length. D2 (Arabic-Indic and Persian digits fold to ASCII), D3 (Chinese/Japanese: the identity key is the whole folded string, no n-grams; titles or artists of 4 or fewer Han/Kana/Hangul characters compared for equality; n-grams belong to the phone's search index, B-84), D4 (Kana and Han variants are aliases, P2-12b), D5 (Turkish ı folds to i), D8 (the phone's Unicode data generated from Python's unicodedata), D9, D10 (nullable ref_merge.title and artist), D12 (version/noise words are data, English-only until N-16 measures): ACCEPTED. CHANGED: D6: ё folds to е (Russian text routinely writes ё as е; keeping it apart would split one song typed two ways); й, ї and ў stay distinct unless the recorded Russian titles show otherwise. D7: a zero-width NON-joiner (U+200C, Persian) becomes a SPACE as in Lucene's Persian filter, so 'می خواهم' typed with a plain space equals the stored title; bidi marks (LRM, RLM, embeddings) are removed with no gap. D11 accepted (the item 'Fix this playlist from its link' is numbered at merge). D13: slices 2 and 3 are ONE PR (keys and call sites move together). D14: size L. survives_fold_whole is defined by P2-25 slice 1; N-34 slice 1 imports it and cannot start before it merges. SAFETY (also in the design): rehome.py re-points song_file rows only and NEVER renames, moves, retags or deletes a file of the Host's own music library (the product works beside a stranger's existing music folder); only files the keeper wrote under Encore/ can ever be moved, by N-34's refile.
